The '''Imperial Garrison''' was an industrial complex converted into a military base by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Imperial forces under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Dracen]] established their base there during the [[Quesh war]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Garrison appears on Quesh in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
